Simulation

Jonathan Morris

2026-11-10

Load functions/packages:

source("sim_mean_sd.R")
library(tidyverse)
## ── Attaching core tidyverse packages ──────────────────────── tidyverse 2.0.0 ──
## ✔ dplyr     1.2.1     ✔ readr     2.2.0
## ✔ forcats   1.0.1     ✔ stringr   1.6.0
## ✔ ggplot2   4.0.3     ✔ tibble    3.3.1
## ✔ lubridate 1.9.5     ✔ tidyr     1.3.2
## ✔ purrr     1.2.2     
## ── Conflicts ────────────────────────────────────────── tidyverse_conflicts() ──
## ✖ dplyr::filter() masks stats::filter()
## ✖ dplyr::lag()    masks stats::lag()
## ℹ Use the conflicted package (<http://conflicted.r-lib.org/>) to force all conflicts to become errors

Create a sim:

output = vector("list", 1000)

for (i in 1:1000) {
  output[[i]] = sim_mean_sd(30)
}

sim_results = bind_rows(output)

Inspect Results:

## Look at mean output:
output |> 
  bind_rows() |> 
  summarize(
    emp_m = mean(mu_hat),
    emp_se = sd(mu_hat)
  )
## # A tibble: 1 × 2
##   emp_m emp_se
##   <dbl>  <dbl>
## 1  2.01  0.548
## Plot outputs:
output |> 
  bind_rows() |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = mu_hat)) +
  geom_density()

DO this using tibbles and map:

sim_results_df = 
  tibble(
    sample_size = rep(30, 1000)
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    est_df = map(sample_size, sim_mean_sd)
    ) |> 
  unnest(est_df)

Look at results:

sim_results_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = mu_hat)) +
  geom_density()

Change n

sim_results_df = 
 expand_grid(
   samp_size = c(30, 60, 120, 240),
   iter = 1:1000
 ) |> 
  mutate(
    est_df = map(samp_size, sim_mean_sd)
    ) |> 
  unnest(est_df)
sim_results_df |> 
  mutate(
    samp_size = str_c("n = ", samp_size),
    samp_size = fct_inorder(samp_size)
  ) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = samp_size, y = mu_hat)) +
  geom_violin()

Simple Linear Regression… !!! (SLR)

sim_data =
  tibble(
    x = rnorm(30, mean = 1, sd = 1),
    y = 2 + 3*x + rnorm(30, mean = 0, sd = 1)
  )

sim_data |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y)) + 
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE)
## `geom_smooth()` using formula = 'y ~ x'

fit = sim_data |> 
  lm(y ~ x, data = _)

Run with sim_slr:

source("sim_slr.R")

slr_results_df = 
 expand_grid(
   samp_size = c(30, 60, 120, 240),
   iter = 1:1000
 ) |> 
  mutate(
    est_df = map(samp_size, sim_slr)
    ) |> 
  unnest(est_df)
slr_results_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = beta0_hat, y = beta1_hat, color = factor(samp_size))) +
  geom_point()

Birthday Problem:

birthdays = sample(1:365, size = 5, replace = TRUE)

repeated_birthdays = length(unique(birthdays)) < 5

print(repeated_birthdays)
## [1] FALSE

turn this into a function

source("birthday_repeated.R")

birthday_repeated(100)
## [1] TRUE

Run it a bunch:

birthday_results_df = 
  tibble(
    number_of_people = rep(5, 10000)
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    repeated = map_lgl(number_of_people, birthday_repeated)
  )

birthday_large_df = 
  expand_grid(
   number_of_people = c(5:100),
   iter = 1:1000
 ) |> 
  mutate(
    repeated = map_lgl(number_of_people, birthday_repeated)
  ) |> 
  group_by(number_of_people) |> 
  summarize(p = mean(repeated))
birthday_large_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = number_of_people, y = p)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line()
